title: Understanding Residuals
text: In a linear regression model, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. The sum of these residuals can tell us something about the model's fit.

title: OLS Model Properties
text: One of the properties of an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model is that the sum of the residuals is always zero. This is because the OLS method minimizes the sum of squared residuals, ensuring that the average of the residuals is zero.

title: Checking the Sum of Residuals
text: Given that the OLS model minimizes the sum of squared residuals, what can we say about the sum of the residuals?
